name: Event Gachapon
description: Limited-release merchandise dispenser. One capsule per eligible claim for the active release. Physical handover after payment and Proof of Human.

capabilities.name: Dispense one capsule
capabilities.description: Dispense a single capsule for this limited release. Requires Proof of Human, scoped authorization, unused claim, and x402 payment before the motor runs.

name: Robotic Arm
description: 4-DOF physical robotic manipulator. Backup actuator for Asp demos — same hire path as the gachapon.

capabilities.name: Reset Arm
capabilities.description: Resets the robotic arm to its home position.

capabilities.name: Arm: Front High
capabilities.description: Moves the robotic arm to the Front High position.

capabilities.name: Arm: Right Reach
capabilities.description: Moves the robotic arm to the Right Reach position.

capabilities.name: Arm: Right Low
capabilities.description: Moves the robotic arm to the Right Low position.
